note: Exact source revisions this app integrates. Branch names are recorded for context only; builds resolve the commit. Components with "merged": false are pinned to a topic-branch commit that is not in the repository's default branch yet.

components.packaging: native executable, built with the repository's scripts/build-android.sh and packaged as lib/<abi>/libzart.so
components.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE at this commit; packaged in assets/licenses/zart/). NOTICE carries the AOSP Apache-2.0 attribution for the arm64 variant tables in crates/zart/src/isa.rs. 11 statically linked Rust crates, all permissive.
components.note: Merge commit of ART PR #2 (parents 19f658d and 8c6cea2; tree identical to 8c6cea2), verified 2026-10-21.

components.packaging: native executable, built with the repository's scripts/build-android.sh and packaged as lib/<abi>/libzthermal.so; the app runs only `zthermal snapshot` (schema_version 1)
components.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE at this commit; packaged in assets/licenses/zthermal/). Statically linked Rust dependencies: MIT OR Apache-2.0, plus foldhash (Zlib), memchr (Unlicense OR MIT), generic-array and zmij (MIT); see the repository's docs/LICENSING.md.
components.note: Merge commit of ThermalTools PR #2 (parents 5358d4d and 9d4b310; tree identical to 9d4b310), verified 2026-10-21. zthermal 0.2.0 is read-only: its validated control list is empty and apply/rollback/backup-config are never invoked by the app.

components.packaging: compact JSON asset generated by integration/scripts/afid_asset.py (assets/afid/device-candidates.json)
components.license: Data: CC BY-SA 3.0 (LineageOS Wiki, adapted by AFID), per the repository NOTICE. AFID code: Apache-2.0 (not packaged).

components.packaging: not packaged separately; the app calls zcored from the installed zairenkai module through root: zcored ctl, protocol v1
components.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE at this commit); no code is copied into the app.
components.note: Core 345fc7f, the merge of Core #3 into dev (its tree differs from the PR commit 8931cbb only in AGENT/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md): adds the tuning adapter (runs ztune capabilities|telemetry|apply; tuning resources stay read-only unless ztune reports an exact-device write authorization) and the tuning method, on top of the single-module paths. Must equal the zairenkai-core commit in Zairenkai-Modules' components.lock.json (build-components.sh checks it).

components.packaging: not packaged separately; the app calls zfasd from the installed zairenkai module through root: zfasd ctl (status schema 1, docs/INTEGRATION.md)
components.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE at this commit); no code is copied into the app.
components.note: FAS 1c453db, the merge of FAS #4 into dev (its tree differs from the PR commit 99cfb18 only in AGENT/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and docs/INTEGRATION.md): data under /data/adb/zairenkai/fas. Must equal the zairenkai-fas commit in Zairenkai-Modules' components.lock.json (build-components.sh checks it).

components.packaging: the single Magisk/KernelSU/APatch module zip (arm64-v8a), assembled by the repository's scripts/assemble.py from the Core, FAS and Tuning commits its components.lock.json pins; packaged as assets/system-modules/zairenkai.zip and installed only on the user's request through the root manager's own installer
components.license: Aggregate: Zairenkai-Modules, Core and FAS are Apache-2.0; ztune (Zairenkai-Tuning 0c226b2) is GPL-3.0-only and ships with its licence and Corresponding Source (source/zairenkai-tuning-<commit>-src.tar.gz) in the zip. Each component's licence files are under licenses/<component>/.
components.note: Modules PR #5 commit 9175e1e (topic branch, not merged yet; re-pin to the merge commit once it is): module 0.3.1, which fixes the install on KernelSU-Next (the installer tested the exec bit before setting it; seen on a device, 2026-10-23), on top of 0.3.0, which adds SHA256SUMS checked at install and at every boot, root-only data directories, own-process uninstall and the WebUI through Core. Components as Modules' components.lock.json pins them: zcored (Core 345fc7f), zfasd (FAS 1c453db) and ztune (Tuning 0c226b2). Previous pins: 2d1f548 (module 0.3.0, PR #3), 298311c (module 0.2.0). Replaces the separate zairenkai_core and zairenkai_fas modules (maintainer decision 2026-10-22).
